stages.name: Task
stages.q: What are we trying to accomplish?
stages.d: Define the job clearly. What question needs answering, what decision needs to be supported, and what does a useful result look like?

stages.name: Context
stages.q: What do we need to know?
stages.d: Bring together the information required to do the work well: filings, transcripts, financials, market data, prior analysis, internal research, and other relevant sources.

stages.name: Process
stages.q: How should the work be done?
stages.d: Define the sequence of steps required to reach the answer. What needs to be retrieved, compared, calculated, tested, or synthesized?

stages.name: Output
stages.d: Turn the analysis into a usable deliverable: a summary, comparison, timeline, model, assessment, or recommendation. The output should support the next action.

stages.name: Review
stages.d: A person validates the work, checks the important assumptions, edits where necessary, and makes the final call. Automation handles the process; judgment stays with the analyst.

cats.name: Earnings
cats.desc: Workflows for earnings analysis and earnings season.

items.title: Earnings Summary
items.desc: Generate a structured, fact-based summary of a company's latest earnings, covering financial performance, key developments, management commentary, and forward-looking signals.
items.inputs: Earnings releases · Filings · Investor presentations · Financial data · Earnings calls
items.output: A structured earnings summary covering financial performance, key developments, management commentary, guidance, and the most important takeaways.

items.title: Key Debates from Earnings
items.desc: Identify the most important debates emerging from an earnings quarter, combining analyst questions, management responses, sentiment, and actionable takeaways.
items.inputs: Earnings call transcripts · Analyst questions · Management commentary · Prior earnings calls · Relevant financial data
items.output: A summary of the key debates from the quarter, including analyst concerns, management responses, areas of disagreement, and actionable takeaways.

items.title: Guidance vs Actuals
items.desc: Compare management guidance with reported performance to assess whether the company beat, met, or missed its commitments.
items.inputs: Earnings calls · Filings · Investor presentations · Financial data · Historical guidance
items.output: A side-by-side view of guidance versus actual performance, including key beats, misses, changes, and outstanding commitments.

items.title: Executive Narrative Tracker
items.desc: Track how management's narrative changes over time to identify shifts in strategy, priorities, risks, and expectations.
items.inputs: Earnings calls · Investor presentations · Filings · Management commentary · Historical company disclosures
items.output: A longitudinal view of management's narrative, highlighting recurring themes, changes in emphasis, strategic shifts, and emerging signals.

items.title: Sector Pulse
items.desc: Identify the biggest themes, trends, and developments emerging across a sector based on what its leading companies are discussing.
items.inputs: Earnings calls · Filings · Investor presentations · Company commentary · Sector data
items.output: A sector-level pulse highlighting the biggest themes companies are discussing, where sentiment is changing, and what developments matter across the sector.

items.title: Earnings Preview
items.desc: Synthesize expectations, prior performance, and key watchpoints into a focused pre-earnings brief.
items.inputs: Consensus estimates · Prior earnings · Management guidance · Analyst commentary · Financial data · Recent company disclosures
items.output: A focused earnings preview covering consensus expectations, what happened last quarter, key metrics to watch, and the issues most likely to drive the upcoming result.

cats.name: Company Research
cats.desc: Workflows for company research and fundamental analysis.

items.title: IPO Prospectus Analysis
items.desc: Extract a structured, investor-focused view of a company from its IPO prospectus.
items.inputs: IPO prospectus · Financial statements · Risk factors · Management commentary · Market data
items.output: An investor-focused IPO analysis covering the business model, financial performance, growth drivers, risks, and key considerations.

items.title: Annual Report Summariser
items.desc: Turn a company's annual report into a structured summary of its business, financial performance, strategy, and risks.
items.inputs: Annual report · Financial statements · Management discussion · Risk disclosures · Notes to accounts
items.output: A structured annual report summary covering the business, financial performance, strategy, risks, and key developments.

items.title: Company Primer
items.desc: Build a comprehensive research brief on a company using filings and relevant public information.
items.inputs: Company filings · Annual reports · Earnings calls · Investor presentations · Financial data · Relevant news
items.output: A comprehensive company primer covering the business model, financials, competitive position, strategy, risks, and investment considerations.

items.title: Management Compensation
items.desc: Analyze executive compensation, ownership, incentives, and governance considerations.
items.inputs: Proxy statements · Annual reports · Filings · Executive disclosures · Compensation tables
items.output: A structured management compensation analysis covering pay, ownership, incentives, changes over time, and potential governance considerations.

items.title: Insider Intelligence Briefing
items.desc: Track insider-related developments across company news and public disclosures over a selected period.
items.inputs: Company filings · Press releases · Company news · Insider disclosures · Relevant market data
items.output: A time-bounded briefing of material insider developments, with relevant company context and key signals highlighted.

items.title: Meeting Brief
items.desc: Prepare a focused briefing for a management meeting, investor call, conference, or company discussion.
items.inputs: Company filings · Earnings calls · Investor presentations · Prior meeting notes · Recent news · Financial data
items.output: A meeting-ready brief covering recent developments, key company context, open questions, and suggested discussion points.

items.title: Business Model Breakdown
items.desc: Break down how a company makes money, creates value, and allocates resources across its business.
items.inputs: Annual reports · Company filings · Investor presentations · Earnings calls · Financial data
items.output: A structured breakdown of the company's business model, revenue drivers, cost structure, economics, dependencies, and key risks.

items.title: Bull Bear Analysis
items.desc: Build a structured two-sided investment thesis by examining the strongest arguments for and against a company.
items.inputs: Company filings · Financial data · Earnings calls · Consensus estimates · Market data · Relevant research
items.output: A balanced investment thesis outlining the bull and bear cases, key assumptions, risks, catalysts, and factors that could change the view.

items.title: Capital Allocation & Strategy Review
items.desc: Assess how management deploys capital and whether allocation decisions align with the company's strategy.
items.inputs: Annual reports · Filings · Earnings calls · Investor presentations · Financial statements · Capital allocation history
items.output: A structured review of capital allocation, strategic priorities, investment outcomes, and changes in management's approach over time.

items.title: 30-Day Catalyst Calendar
items.desc: Identify the company events and developments most likely to matter over the next 30 days.
items.inputs: Company filings · Investor relations materials · Earnings calendar · Regulatory disclosures · Press releases · Market data
items.output: A 30-day catalyst calendar showing upcoming events, expected dates, relevant context, and the potential impact of each catalyst.

cats.name: Competition
cats.desc: Workflows for competitive and peer analysis.

items.title: Peer Analysis
items.desc: Produce a side-by-side, filings-based comparison of multiple companies over a defined period.
items.inputs: Company filings · Annual reports · Earnings releases · Financial data · Operating metrics
items.output: A side-by-side peer comparison highlighting relative financial performance, operating metrics, key differences, and areas of competitive strength or weakness.

cats.name: News & Events
cats.desc: Workflows for financial news and market monitoring.

items.title: Event-Driven Stock Price Analysis
items.desc: Analyze significant stock price movements and identify the events and developments that may have driven them.
items.inputs: Stock price data · Company filings · Press releases · Earnings announcements · Regulatory news · Market news
items.output: An event-driven analysis linking major stock price movements to their most likely catalysts, with relevant company and market context.

items.title: Last Week News Roundup
items.desc: Summarize the most important news and developments affecting a company over the previous week.
items.inputs: Company news · Filings · Press releases · Regulatory disclosures · Market news · Relevant media coverage
items.output: A concise weekly news roundup highlighting the most material company developments, why they matter, and any emerging themes.

items.title: Business Updates
items.desc: Summarize material business developments disclosed through a company's official filings and announcements.
items.inputs: Company filings · Press releases · Investor presentations · Regulatory disclosures · Official company announcements
items.output: A structured summary of material business updates, including what changed, when it happened, and why it matters.
